514:t_3:120.en:
$$ディアッカ$$
「Hey, hey! You intend to make do with first aid?」

514:t_3:121.en:
$$キラ$$
「We've achieved our objective. So we have to go.」

514:t_3:123.en:
$$イザーク$$
「We'll strike the people who infiltrated $$プラント$$. We'll leave the enemies outside to you.」

514:t_4:4.en:
$$ラクス$$
「To everyone watching this broadcast: I am $$ラクス・クライン$$, a member of the $$プラント$$ Supreme Council.」

514:t_4:5.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Today, $$プラント$$ has decided to reorganize its nonfunctioning council and review its cooperation with $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

514:t_4:6.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Defense Committee Chairman $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$ has also resigned, and a successor is being selected.」

514:t_4:7.en:
$$ラクス$$
「We will announce future policies as they are decided. First, we wish to reaffirm that we are part of a world moving beyond its past toward the future.」

514:t_4:8.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Is abandoning our pride and submitting to invaders truly the future we desire?」

514:t_4:9.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Of course, winning that future will require sacrifices.」

514:t_4:10.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But if we fear them, we will make no progress and be left behind by our era and the world.」

514:t_4:11.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Problems like the falling birthrate of third-generation $$コーディネイター$$s may stem from living only within $$プラント$$'s closed world.」

514:t_4:12.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Now we must overcome the old barrier between $$ナチュラル$$s and $$コーディネイター$$s, and join hands as people living together in this world.」

514:t_4:13.en:
$$ラクス$$
「As a result... The genetic engineering technology of $$コーディネイター$$s may fade away.」

514:t_4:14.en:
$$ラクス$$
「But as long as we remember our role as the world's coordinators, as our forefather $$ジョージ・グレン$$ said, our existence will be eternal.」

514:t_4:15.en:
$$ラクス$$
「Many difficulties lie before us now.」

514:t_4:16.en:
$$ラクス$$
「I ask for your cooperation so that we can overcome them and seize the future.」

514:t_4:21.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「...$$ラクス$$ is impressive, isn't she?」

514:t_4:22.en:
$$キラ$$
「Yes... She seems to have grown stronger again.」

514:t_4:23.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「We faced our share of hardships during these past few months underground.」

514:t_4:24.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「But you don't need to worry about $$プラント$$ anymore. Many support the Defense Committee Chairman's resignation, and unrest within $$ザフト$$ isn't too severe.」

514:t_4:25.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Above all, $$ラクス$$'s announcement in her speech that the alliance with $$ネオ・ジオン$$ was dissolved seems to have made a big difference.」

514:t_4:27.en:
$$メイリン$$
「So, Sis... Leave $$プラント$$ to us.」

514:t_4:29.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Once the Supreme Council functions properly, $$プラント$$ will gradually regain stability. Then we can prepare to strike back at the Empire.」

514:t_4:30.en:
$$シン$$
「$$プラント$$ is joining the war too!?」

514:t_4:31.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Of course we'd prefer to avoid war.」

514:t_4:32.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「But $$ラクス$$ said it, didn't she? Yielding to invaders is like giving up our future.」

514:t_4:33.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「No one sees the fighting on Earth as someone else's problem anymore. It's late, but $$ザフト$$ will fight the Empire too.」

514:t_4:35.en:
$$シン$$
「Um... Then... What happened to $$レイ#pt136$$...?」

514:t_4:36.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「$$アーサー$$ reported that he let him escape, and lost the $$レジェンド$$ too.」

514:t_4:37.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「He's capable, but he does have a careless streak. He needs a proper lecture sometime.」

514:t_4:38.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Well, we're busy moving to the new administration, so I'll leave the Defense Committee Chairman to you.」

514:t_4:40.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「There's no need to thank me. ...I'm sure he too was trying to protect the $$コーディネイター$$s' future.」

514:t_4:41.en:
$$バルトフェルド$$
「Then we'll meet again, $c. I wish you luck in your battles.」

514:t_4:42.en:
$$キラ$$
「You haven't changed either, $$バルトフェルド$$...」

514:t_4:44.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「...I intend to atone with my own hands.」

514:t_4:46.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「It's true that lives were lost because I joined forces with $$フロンタル$$.」

514:t_4:47.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「For those people too, I want to fight with $c.」

514:t_4:48.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「I understand, $$レイ・ザ・バレル$$. ...At least I, as a member of $$ソレスタルビーイング$$, have no right to condemn you.」

514:t_4:49.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「As you just said, if you have convictions, I'll have you show them through your actions.」

514:t_4:51.en:
$$カミーユ$$
「We're counting on you from now on, $$レイ#pt136$$.」

514:t_4:52.en:
$$ガロード$$
「Let me warn you, $c's battles are tougher than you imagine.」

514:t_4:54.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
「But as long as $$シン$$ is with me, I can keep fighting.」

514:t_4:56.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
($$ギル$$... I don't know how long my life will last...)

514:t_4:57.en:
$$レイ#pt136$$
(But until it ends, I'll fight to protect the future you entrusted to us...)

514:t_4:59.en:
$$アムロ$$
「You worked hard too, $$アスラン$$.」

514:t_4:62.en:
$$アスラン$$
「...Thinking back now, I realized Chairman $$デュランダル$$ was also trying to fulfill the role of the world's coordinator...」

514:t_4:64.en:
$$アムロ$$
「We can't accept the $$デスティニープラン$$, but there are signs that the Chairman sought to escape a world ruled by $$クロノ$$.」

514:t_4:65.en:
$$キラ$$
(That's the true meaning hidden in the $$デスティニープラン$$...)

514:t_4:66.en:
$$アムロ$$
「That's precisely why we, who stopped him, must go beyond that.」

514:t_4:67.en:
$$アスラン$$
「Where do we go beyond that...?」

514:t_4:68.en:
$$アムロ$$
「I don't know either. But I'm sure the Chairman's or $$フロンタル$$'s methods won't get us there.」

514:t_4:69.en:
$$キラ$$
「Now that we've weakened $$ネオ・ジオン$$ and separated $$ザフト$$ from them, the counteroffensive against the Empire will finally begin.」

514:t_4:70.en:
$$アムロ$$
「Yes. We'll likely return to the $$ソレスタルビーイング号$$ once and discuss our strategy from here.」

514:t_4:71.en:
$$アムロ$$
(Hurry, $$シャア$$... Soon the time to decide everything will come.)

514:t_4:72.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I can't imagine $$フロンタル$$ staying quiet after losing $$ハマーン$$ and $$ザフト$$.)

514:t_4:73.en:
$$アムロ$$
(I'm waiting, $$シャア$$. Your presence will surely bring this war to an end...)

514:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Good work, $$マリーダ$$. Dealing with $$リディ$$ must have been difficult.」

514:t_10:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Take my advice. Approaching that man is dangerous after all.」

514:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I understand you're concerned about him now that he's piloting the same machine, but one wrong move, and your life could...!」

514:t_10:7.en:
$$マリーダ$$
「But he produced $$Ｚチップ$$s, didn't he?」

kept_omissions: 514:t_10:6: AG's warning about Marida's life ends with an unspoken consequence; her next row interrupts him.
